name: Spark Mail
tagline: Spark is a smart email client for iOS, macOS, and Android with AI features including Smart Inbox that automatically prioritises important emails, AI reply suggestions, email scheduling, and a collaborative email drafting mode for teams. It connects to Gmail, Outlook, and iCloud accounts.
